text:
anya: heads-up: deploy-bot paused promotion for release/v2.9.0 — embeddings.p95 jumped right after merge. Holding traffic.
deploy-bot: SAFETY_HOLD: embeddings.p95 > threshold (2x). Suggested actions: investigate, pin, or rollback.
sam: We have a legal-approved change window at 14:00. Auto-rollback could impact dedicated/reserved pools. Thoughts?
ops-leo: Manual operator action preferred. We should avoid flipping dedicated pools during the change window. Suggest pin hosted endpoints only and keep tiny canary for telemetry.
anya: Agreed. Ops, apply routing pin for hosted embeddings to previous stable tag v2.8.7, keep 1% canary on v2.9.0, and suppress auto-rollback. Reason: "immediate p95 spike post-merge"
ops-leo: Running: `routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.8.7 --canary 1 --reason "immediate p95 spike post-merge"`
ops-leo: Pin applied. Hosted embeddings traffic: 99% -> v2.8.7, 1% canary on v2.9.0. Auto-rollback suppressed by operator.
sre-jen: Looking at telemetry: KV cache eviction rate and a small bump in host GC around the merge window. Could be runtime kernel change or kv-format mismatch. Opening ticket INF-3142.
product-alex: Will customers notice functional impact? Need to coordinate messaging if we keep pin through the change window.
kate: Drafting customer advisory: "Temporary routing pin to previous version for embeddings due to increased latency after deploy; monitoring closely." Would you like me to mention ETA for next update?
anya: Yes, include ETA 30m and note we are investigating root cause. Avoid SLA wording.
sam: Rollback decision criteria proposal: if embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> execute targeted rollback for embeddings to v2.8.6. If dedicated-customer error_rate > 0.25% for 3m escalate to oncall and consider targeted rollback for those pools.
sre-jen: I agree. Also add a quick regression test for KV shapes to the post-merge CI and link INF-3142.
ops-leo: Running a warmup on v2.8.7 nodes and quick smoke now: login OK, embeddings-create latency back to baseline ~220ms, sample quality 98/100.
product-alex: Good. That should be safe for the scheduled change window. We'll tell sales/legal we're keeping hosted pinned and not touching dedicated pools.
kate: Customer note queued; will send if stable for 15m. (:mailbox_with_mail:)
ops-leo: Follow-up after pin: embeddings p95 on pinned traffic 215ms, canary telemetry 1% shows same spike but low sample size.
anya: Keep suppression for 1 hour and monitor. If INF-3142 lands a hotfix, plan an A/B reroll at 10% hosted-only with auto-rollback enabled for that experiment.
sre-jen: I'll own INF-3142 and coordinate ML and runtime teams. Will post PR link in this thread.
sam: Also preparing a short release-note blurb: "v2.9.0 embeddings promotion paused for further validation; routing temporarily pinned. Fix in progress."
anya: Closing loop for now: manual pin applied, auto-rollback suppressed, smoke verified, INF-3142 opened. Reopen thread if metrics change. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
